summary: 3DNow!-optimized 4x4 matrix operator. Reads an input matrix a3 as eight packed-float qwords (16 floats) and builds intermediate cofactor/row terms with 3DNow! multiply/subtract/add instructions, accumulating a scalar whose low 32 bits are exposed through a2 when a2 is non-null. When that scalar is non-zero, the cofactor terms are scaled by its reciprocal (pfrcp plus two-step refinement, sign-adjusted by the packed constant 0xBF8000003F800000) and written into the output matrix a1[0..7]. When the scalar is zero the output is left unmodified and -1 is returned. Called by F_3DNow44MatrixMultiplyWrapper and MatrixInterpolationBlend; structural twin of sub_522B22 per the cluster_copy prelabel.

operations.description: Load the input matrix a3 as eight packed-float qwords (a3[0..7], 16 floats) and compute intermediate cofactor/row terms (v5..v29, v44..v50) using 3DNow! mul/sub/add/pack sequences.
Combine the packed terms into scalar v30 and horizontal-accumulate with _m_pfacc into v31; this scalar doubles as the divisor/scale term used by the inverse path.
When a2 is non-null, write the low 32 bits of the accumulated scalar v31 into *a2 (_mm_cvtsi64_si32 on v31).
Compute a zero-compare of v31 (_m_pfcmpeq(0, v31)); when the result is non-zero (v31 == 0, degenerate matrix) skip the inversion block and return immediately.
Compute a reciprocal approximation of v31 with _m_pfrcp and refine it via _m_pfrcpit1/_m_pfrcpit2, applying the packed sign constant 0xBF8000003F800000 (-1.0/+1.0) to the product.
Write the scaled result into output matrix a1[0..7] as eight qwords at byte offsets 0x0 (RW), 0x8, 0x10, 0x18, 0x20, 0x28, 0x30 and 0x38, each formed by packing the scaled row/column terms.
Return 0 when the scalar is non-zero (invertible path executed), or -1 when the scalar is zero (degenerate; output matrix left untouched).
